news.title: Rift Breach Expeditions
news.body: E through S-grade Breaches are live with populated rooms, hidden bosses, timers, cache choices, and grade-matched admission sigils. Use /breach for status.

news.title: Regional Events
news.body: Eight regions now feature distinct local events, enemy families, resources, bosses, and rewards. Use /events to see what is active and where.

news.title: Breach Sigil Compensation
news.body: Players who completed sigil-awarding contracts before the update receive their missing sigils automatically when they log in.

news.title: Server Address
news.body: Use nosivad.bounceme.net at the Legends of Aria Eternal server login screen.
